technical.summary: Solid uptrend structure with price above all moving averages and bullish EMA cross, but overbought conditions and lack of volume confirmation limit high-probability swing entry quality.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying activity or institutional position data available; insufficient smart money signals to establish conviction ahead of earnings in 61 days.

sentiment.summary: Broad market sentiment is a headwind with Fear index at 30 providing contrarian buy opportunity, while neutral AAII and COT readings lack conviction; no congressional signals available to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Elevated VIX at 30.5 combined with imminent FOMC decision (passed event date) creates unfavourable conditions; entry blocked due to event risk and volatility spike.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with price above all major moving averages and ADX confirmation establish solid uptrend structure and technical momentum for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Elevated VIX at 30.5 with trade-blocking event risk, overbought Williams %R, BB squeeze, lack of volume confirmation via OBV, and weak fundamental/sentiment conviction create unfavourable risk-reward for entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Trade blocked by elevated VIX (30.5) and imminent FOMC event risk; overbought technicals (Williams %R) lack volume confirmation despite EMA golden cross.
decision.primary_risk: Macro headwinds with unfavourable VIX environment and event-driven volatility spike eliminate acceptable risk-reward for swing entry.
